METHOD NAME=once CODE=local void once(once_t *state, void (*init)(void)) {\n    if (!atomic_load(&state->done)) {\n        if (atomic_flag_test_and_set(&state->begun))\n            while (!atomic_load(&state->done))\n                ;\n        else {\n            init();\n            atomic_store(&state->done, 1);\n        }\n    }\n} FULL_NAME=once SIGNATURE=void(once_t*,void) ORDER=1
  METHOD_PARAMETER_IN NAME=state CODE=once_t *state TYPE_FULL_NAME=once_t* ORDER=1
  METHOD_PARAMETER_OUT NAME=state CODE=once_t *state TYPE_FULL_NAME=once_t* ORDER=1
  METHOD_PARAMETER_IN NAME=init CODE=void (*init)(void) TYPE_FULL_NAME=void ORDER=2
  METHOD_PARAMETER_OUT NAME=init CODE=void (*init)(void) TYPE_FULL_NAME=void ORDER=2
  BLOCK CODE={\n    if (!atomic_load(&state->done)) {\n        if (atomic_flag_test_and_set(&state->begun))\n            while (!atomic_load(&state->done))\n                ;\n        else {\n            init();\n            atomic_store(&state->done, 1);\n        }\n    }\n} TYPE_FULL_NAME=void ORDER=3
